authority: Dependency locks remain required decision state for reproducible strict/release identity. A missing lock may receive a narrow portable exception only when the corresponding package-manager executable that would generate it is objectively unavailable on the executing host.

tool_unavailable_exception.detection: Automatic executable discovery on PATH by the dependency-lock checker. No manual flag, environment override, placeholder lock, or prose assertion may establish the exception.
tool_unavailable_exception.source_intake: Permitted for a source-candidate only when every missing lock is covered by this exception. The intake result does not claim complete dependency identity.
tool_unavailable_exception.release_package_intake: Forbidden. Accepted/release package intake always requires complete lockfiles and lockSetSha256.
tool_unavailable_exception.invalidation: The exception ceases to apply immediately when the corresponding generator executable becomes available; the lock must then be generated and validated before the lock check can pass.
must_not: Report the dependency-lock check as PASS while a required lock is missing.
Permit STRICT_ACCEPTED or RELEASE_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED without complete dependency identity.
Treat a package-manager command failure or unavailable network as equivalent to an unavailable executable.
